title: feat(core,types)!: retire the module widget source and its runtime dynamic import (objectui#13450)
body:
Fixes #13450

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

Retires the `module` widget source. `WidgetRegistry.load()` resolved `{ type: 'module', url }` with `new Function('url', 'return import(url)')`. That is the runtime dynamic import AGENTS.md commandment `#6` forbids ("No `eval()` / runtime dynamic imports to load components"). The claim is the PM's comment `6386913269` on the card, for branch `claude/issue-13450-retire-widget-module-source`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01432GBvPzfZ6CsLanp9xzkZ`.

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/types`**: the `module` member and its `WidgetSourceModule` interface are removed. `RuntimeWidgetSource` is now `WidgetSourceInline | WidgetSourceRegistry`, and the barrel no longer exports `WidgetSourceModule`. The union's docblock records the retirement and the migration. The manifest's JSDoc `@example` now uses `{ type: 'inline', component }` with a locally defined `CustomChart` component (the build-time import is named in a comment, so the block compiles in isolation under `check-doc-example-types`) instead of a URL.
- **`@object-ui/core`**: the `case 'module'` arm and its Function-constructor sink are removed from `WidgetRegistry.resolveComponent()`. The `default:` arm is now exhaustive (`const unhandled: never = source`), so a union member added without an arm fails to compile.
  - An untyped manifest that still reaches `load()` with `type: 'module'` is refused by name before anything is fetched. Untyped means plain JS, a cast, or an older `@object-ui/types`. The error names the widget, the retired `"module"` source and both replacements.
  - Any other unknown type is refused with the supported types listed.
  - In both cases `load()` emits `widget:error` and `loadAll()` reports the error. The class docblock and its example no longer mention URL loading.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/13450-retire-widget-module-source.md`: `minor` for core and types. objectui never declares `major` (`check-changeset-no-major`); the break is stated in the body as **BREAKING**. The changeset gives the FROM → TO migration and the one-line fix, and carries the `Clause-②:` / `Metadata-protocol:` lines.
- `page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts`: the reason string in one `it.each` row said "module/inline/registry loader union" and now says "inline/registry". It is a test title, not an assertion.

## Migration (FROM → TO)

- FROM `source: { type: 'module', url: '/widgets/chart.js', exportName: 'Chart' }`
- TO `import { Chart } from './widgets/chart'` and `source: { type: 'inline', component: Chart }` (imported at build time, so the bundler sees it)
- OR `ComponentRegistry.register('chart', Chart)` once, and `source: { type: 'registry', registryKey: 'chart' }`

## Premise check: the card's "four emitting sites" are not widget sources

The card and the triage route name four `type: 'module'` producers. Each one was read in context at `a3c0da9`. All four are the generated **`package.json`'s ESM marker** (`"type": "module"`), not a widget manifest source. Deleting them would make the scaffolded packages CommonJS and break their `import` syntax. **None was changed:**

| Site (by symbol) | What it builds | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `buildAppPackageJson` in `packages/cli/src/utils/app-generator.ts` | temp app `package.json` (`name`, `private`, `type`, deps) | package.json ESM marker; kept |
| `buildRoutedAppPackageJson` in the same file | routed temp app `package.json` | package.json ESM marker; kept |
| `buildInitPackageJson` in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` | `objectui init` project `package.json` (`scripts.dev: 'vite'`) | package.json ESM marker; kept |
| `buildPackageJson` in `packages/create-plugin/src/templates.ts` | generated plugin `package.json` (`main`, `module`, `exports`) | package.json ESM marker; kept |

So `@object-ui/cli` and `@object-ui/create-plugin` carry no change and no changeset, which narrows the route. No widget-manifest producer of a `module` source exists in this tree. A `git grep` for `WidgetSourceModule` before this change hit only its declaration and the barrel. `apps/console/src` and `packages/app-shell/src` construct no `module` source (triage's reading). `objectstack` and `hotcrm` reference neither `WidgetRegistry` nor `RuntimeWidgetSource` in code (the only `objectstack` hit is a doc paragraph that does not name the `module` source). Out-of-tree consumers are NOT MEASURED.

No user-facing doc names the `module` widget source. `content/docs`, the package READMEs and `docs/` were checked with `git grep`; the control `ComponentRegistry` hits in `content/docs`. The two JSDoc examples were the only documentation of it, and both are rewritten.

## Tests (head `e15036c`)

- `be01ada` (patch round): `check-doc-example-types` exit 1 → 0 (34 → 35 compile; `WidgetRegistry #1` back on its TS2304 ledger row). JSDoc text only.

New `describe('the retired \`module\` source (objectui#13450)')` in `packages/core/src/registry/__tests__/WidgetRegistry.test.ts`:

1. A manifest with `source: { type: 'module', url }` is refused. The rejection is an `Error` that names `"test-widget"`, `"module"`, `type: 'inline'` and `type: 'registry'`; these are the named subjects, not the wording. The global `Function` constructor, proxied for construct and apply, records zero calls. Nothing is marked loaded or synced into the component registry. The literal carries `@ts-expect-error`, so the type-level refusal is pinned too: core's `type-check` runs `tsconfig.test.json`, which includes `src/**/*.test.ts`.
2. `loadAll()` reports the refusal for that widget, a sibling still loads, and `widget:error` fires.
3. An unknown type (`remote`) is refused with `"inline"` and `"registry"` named and no "retired" wording.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/ --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 211 passed (211)`, `Tests 4089 passed | 27 skipped (4116)`
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 388 passed (388)`, `Tests 10568 passed (10568)`
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/core run type-check`: both `Done`, exit 0. This ran after both packages were rebuilt, so core's test program read the new `dist/*.d.ts`.

**Ablation, runtime** (one-shot, through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob): a `case 'module'` arm with the Function-constructor import was re-planted ahead of `default:`. On-disk marker count was 1, sink count 1. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 24 passed (26)`. Test 1 received `"A dynamic import callback was not specified."` instead of the refusal; test 2 failed the same way. Test 3 stayed green, which is the expected direction. After the restore, `git diff HEAD` was empty and the blob equalled HEAD. A first attempt used an anchor that the replacement re-contained; the tool refused it and nothing ran.

**Reverse verification, types** (cross-package): a `{ type: 'module'; url: string }` member was re-added to `RuntimeWidgetSource` and `@object-ui/types` rebuilt; the dist marker count was 1. Core's `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` then reported `TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive` on the new test and `TS2322 ... is not assignable to type 'never'` on the exhaustive arm. After the restore and a rebuild, the dist marker count was 0 and the same `tsc` was green.

## Gates (local, at `e15036c`)

Exit codes were captured to a file before reading:

- `lint` (core + types): exit 0. 0 errors; the warnings are all pre-existing `no-explicit-any`, and none is on a changed line.
- `check:new-line-citations` 0 · `check:control-bytes` 0 · `check-changeset-presence` 0 · `changeset:check` (fixed + no-major) 0 · `check:changeset-claims` 0 · `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0 · `check:spec-symbols` 0 · `check:unreferenced-sources` 0 · `check:doc-example-readers` 0 · `check:shell-escape-residue` 0 · `check:test-path-roots` 0
- `check:readme-exports`: exit 1, NOT MEASURED for the repo as a whole. The only unjudged population is `@object-ui/app-shell`, which was unbuilt; every other package was judged with `0 fabricated, 0 wrong-path`. No README names `WidgetSourceModule`.
- `check:published-dist`: exit 1, NOT MEASURED. Its internal whole-workspace `turbo run build` hit a heap OOM in `@object-ui/app-shell`, so it judged nothing. That is environmental and not this diff. CI owns this gate.

`origin/main` was merged before opening; it had not moved from the branch base `a3c0da9`, so the merge was a no-op. objectui#13442 is in flight in the same batch on disjoint files (`packages/core/src/actions/**` and the `DataSource` type). The only shared surface is the `@object-ui/types` barrel, where this PR removes a single line in the widget block.

## Acceptance notes

- Remote widgets as a product capability (a signed manifest and an allow-listed origin, decided in spec) are the maintainer's call and are not part of this card, per the triage ruling.
- `register()` still accepts a manifest with a retired or unknown source, and the refusal happens at `load()`. That matches the ruling's "refuse an old manifest loudly in `default:`" and how the registry already treats a missing `registryKey`.
